title: Latency hop log line
description: One structured line each data-path service logs per request (logger 'hop', level INFO), keyed by x-correlator, for per-stage latency aggregation. See docs/latency-instrumentation.md.

event.description: Selector for these lines in a mixed log stream.

service.description: Emitting service, e.g. camara-gateway, positioning-engine, wifi-adapter, vendor-adapter, synthetic-adapter. Open: a private adapter emits its own name.

correlator.description: The x-correlator; the join key across services.

t_receive.description: Unix epoch seconds (float) at request receipt.

t_emit.description: Unix epoch seconds (float) at response emit.

span_ms.description: t_emit - t_receive in milliseconds; this hop's own service time (includes time waited on downstream hops).

cache.description: Present on a stage that keeps a cache of the source behind it, whose calls write no hop line of their own: the vendor-adapter's GET /measurement/{id}. `hit`: answered from the cache, the source was not called. `miss`: the source was called, whatever it answered.
